title: UI风格#138 - Nordic Forest (北欧森林)
description: 创建第138种UI风格：北欧森林风格 - 松树、苔藓、极夜、宁静。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planEH.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Forest style When color palette Then features pine green, moss, bark brown, snow white, midnight blue
Given Nordic Forest style When typography Then uses nordic fonts: Josefin Sans, Montserrat, or Nunito
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: Josefin Sans (headers 2.2rem 300 weight), Montserrat (body 0.95rem 400-600 weight)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Forest style When layout Then forest canopy, moss carpet, birch trees, frozen streams
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: forest gradient background (deep green to snow white), fog overlay, forest border with pine emoji, nature-themed layout

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Forest style When UI elements Then pine needles, fog layers, snow falling, wood grain
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: fog radial gradients, pine tree emoji accents (🌲🌿🏕🦌🏔❄), forest green color scheme with moss and snow white accents

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Forest UI When functional Then includes forest chat, ranger agents, nature stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: forest chat (Forest Trail), 4 ranger agents (DEV PINE, RAG DEER, PM PEAK, TEST FROST) with Trail/Wild/Forest/Moss/Summit/Vista/Snow/Frost stats

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Nordic Forest UI When copy Then uses forest nature: 'Forest', 'Ranger', 'Wild', 'Nature'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implemented: title 'FOREST. RANGER. WILD.', tagline '~ Where silence speaks ~', button 'HIKE', greeting 'The forest welcomes you, traveler. The path is clear, the air is fresh.', status 'ACTIVE'/'IDLE', nav 'Forest'/'Hike'/'Explore'/'Lodge'
